arxiv-2007-04496.title: Fast neural Poincaré maps for toroidal magnetic fields
arxiv-2007-04496.creator: J. W. Burby, Q. Tang, R. Maulik
arxiv-2007-04496.description: Abstract Poincaré maps for toroidal magnetic fields are routinely employed to study gross confinement properties in devices built to contain hot plasmas. In most practical applications, evaluating a Poincaré map requires numerical integration of a magnetic field line, a process that can be slow and that cannot be easily accelerated using parallel computations.

arxiv-2303-10807.title: Statistical inference for discretely sampled stochastic functional differential equations with small noise E-mail: shimizu@waseda.jp
arxiv-2303-10807.creator: Hiroki Nemoto
arxiv-2303-10807.description: Abstract Estimating parameters of drift and diffusion coefficients for multidimensional stochastic delay equations with small noise are considered. The delay structure is written as an integral form with respect to a delay measure. Our contrast function is based on a local-Gauss approximation to the transition probability density of the process.

arxiv-2407-19986.title: On geometrically C 1 C_{1} fields Thanks: During this research, the author received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No 101034255 and was also supported by the program GeoMod ANR-19-CE40-0022-01 (ANR-DFG
arxiv-2407-19986.creator: Konstantinos Kartas
arxiv-2407-19986.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Konstantinos Kartas. A field k k is called geometrically C 1 C_{1} if every smooth projective separably rationally connected k k -variety has a k k -rational point. Given a henselian valued field of equal characteristic 0 0 with divisible value group, we show that the property of being geometrically C 1 C_{1} lifts from the residue field to the valued field. We also prove that algebraically maximal valued fields with divisible value group and finite residue field are geometrically C 1 C_{1} .

arxiv-2410-10394.title: PIVOT-R: Primitive-Driven Waypoint-Aware World Model for Robotic Manipulation
arxiv-2410-10394.creator: Kaidong Zhang, Pengzhen Ren, Bingqian Lin, Junfan Lin, Shikui Ma Hang Xu Xiaodan Liang
arxiv-2410-10394.description: Abstract Language-guided robotic manipulation is a challenging task that requires an embodied agent to follow abstract user instructions to accomplish various complex manipulation tasks. Previous work generally maps instructions and visual perceptions directly to low-level executable actions, neglecting the modeling of critical waypoints ( e.g. , key states of “close to/grab/move up” in action trajectories) in manipulation tasks.

arxiv-2511-07574.title: HyProv: Hybrid Provenance Management for Scientific Workflows
arxiv-2511-07574.creator: Vasilis Bountris, Lauritz Thamsen, Ulf Leser
arxiv-2511-07574.description: Abstract Provenance plays a crucial role in scientific workflow execution, for instance by providing data for failure analysis, real-time monitoring, or statistics on resource utilization for right-sizing allocations. The workflows themselves, however, become increasingly complex in terms of involved components. Furthermore, they are executed on distributed cluster infrastructures, which makes the real-time collection, integration, and analysis of provenance data challenging.

arxiv-2512-09593.title: WASP-12, shrouded in mystery or just cold gas? WASP-12, shrouded in mystery or just cold gas? – References 2023
arxiv-2512-09593.creator: Simon Daley-Yates, Ricarda S. Beckmann, Lewis McCallum, Moira M. Jardine, Andrew C. Cameron
arxiv-2512-09593.description: Abstract Observations of the planet-hosting star WASP-12 show a distinctive depression in the Mg ii and Ca ii resonance lines. This has been interpreted as a marker of atmospheric loss from the close-in hot Jupiter WASP-12b and the resulting formation of a gas torus around the star.

pmc-10660455.title: Comparative Efficacy and Safety of Statin Monotherapy and Statin plus Ezetimibe Combination in a Real-World Setting
pmc-10660455.creator: Marat V Ezhov, Igor V Sergienko, Sergey M Kryzhanovskiy, Kirill S Manko, Elena V Timoshina, Omar Cauli, Alan Richardson
pmc-10660455.description: Background: The objective of this study was to conduct a comparative evaluation of the effectiveness of ezetimibe in combination with statins or statin monotherapy in patients with hypercholesterolemia in a real-world setting. Methods: It was a retrospective multicenter observational study conducted in Russia. We included patients who received statins or a combination of statins with ezetimibe for ≥3 months.

pmc-10669841.title: Morphological and Functional Principles Governing the Plasticity Reserve in the Cerebellum: The Cortico-Deep Cerebellar Nuclei Loop Model
pmc-10669841.creator: Hiroshi Mitoma, Shinji Kakei, Hirokazu Tanaka, Mario Manto
pmc-10669841.description: Simple SummaryWe propose a more comprehensive scheme underlying cerebellar reserve. Under pathological conditions, the internal forward model continuously updates itself to adjust the predictive control, where two reorganizing steps function cooperatively: updating predictions in the residual or affected cerebellar cortex (predictive step) and adjusting the updated predictions with the current status at the cerebellar nuclei (filtering step).

pmc-11366828.title: Posttransplant complications: molecular mechanisms and therapeutic interventions
pmc-11366828.creator: Xiaoyou Liu, Junyi Shen, Hongyan Yan, Jianmin Hu, Guorong Liao, Ding Liu, Song Zhou, Jie Zhang, Jun Liao, Zefeng Guo, Yuzhu Li, Siqiang Yang, Shichao Li, Hua Chen, Ying Guo, Min Li, Lipei Fan, Liuyang Li, Peng Luo, Ming Zhao, Yongguang Liu
pmc-11366828.description: Posttransplantation complications pose a major challenge to the long‐term survival and quality of life of organ transplant recipients. These complications encompass immune‐mediated complications, infectious complications, metabolic complications, and malignancies, with each type influenced by various risk factors and pathological mechanisms.

pmc-11545285.title: Prevalence of Alexithymia and Associated Factors Among Dental Students in Saudi Arabia: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11545285.creator: Hebah M Hamdan, Ghaida Alislimah, Hessa Alshalawi, Khawlah Alharbi, Mohammed I Alsaif, Ayman M Sulimany, Marie Thomas
pmc-11545285.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Mental health challenges among university students are pervasive, with alexithymia posing a particularly significant yet understudied challenge. This condition significantly affects an individual’s ability to cope with stress due to difficulties in recognizing, describing, and processing emotions. Objectives: This study aims to evaluate alexithymia prevalence and its associated factors among dental undergraduate students and interns enrolled at King Saud University in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

pmc-12576143.title: Pancreatic Intraductal Papillary Mucinous Neoplasm With Invasive Carcinoma Concomitant With Ampullary Neuroendocrine Tumor: A Case Report
pmc-12576143.creator: Jingcheng Zhang, Jianhao Huang, Xiaodong He, Mengqing Sun, Xianlin Han
pmc-12576143.description: This case reports a rare co‐occurrence of pancreatic intraductal papillary mucinous neoplasm with invasive carcinoma and ampullary neuroendocrine tumor. Laparoscopic pancreaticoduodenectomy was done. No recurrence/metastasis in 12‐month follow‐up, though both tumors had lymph node metastasis, warranting attention to timely biopsy.

pmc-12670878.title: Ground-based imagery dataset for early weed classification in tomato crops
pmc-12670878.creator: Hugo Moreno, Gabriel Rivera, Dionisio Andújar
pmc-12670878.description: Accurate identification of weed species at early developmental stages is essential for advancing precision agriculture. Species-level classification enables site-specific management strategies, reducing herbicide use and promoting sustainable crop production. This study introduces a curated dataset of RGB images captured using a handheld Canon PowerShot SX540 HS camera, offering a spatial resolution of 5184 × 3888 pixels.

pmc-13054611.title: Endothelial stress as reflected by EASIX predicts cardiovascular morbidity and mortality: Insights from a nationally representative cohort
pmc-13054611.creator: Yu Xia, Mei Wang
pmc-13054611.description: BackgroundEndothelial dysfunction (ED) is a key pathophysiological mechanism in cardiovascular diseases (CVD). The Endothelial Activation and Stress Index (EASIX), derived from routine laboratory markers, has been proposed as a surrogate indicator of endothelial stress. However, its relevance to CVD burden and long-term outcomes in the general population remains uncertain.

pmc-13196917.title: Harnessing the stem cell potential in the human hippocampus to limit cognitive aging
pmc-13196917.creator: Susmit Mhatre, Darcie L. Moore
pmc-13196917.description: The field of human adult neurogenesis has been controversial despite mounting evidence. The authors propose moving beyond debating the existence of adult neurogenesis and towards discovering strategies to harness endogenous stem cell potential for resilience against cognitive aging. Cognitive decline is an unwelcome part of "normal" aging.

pmc-13249530.title: Photobiomodulation outperforms ultrasound in reducing IL-1β-driven chondrocyte inflammation
pmc-13249530.creator: Sofia Oliveira, Débora Ferreira, Ligia R. Rodrigues, Filipe S. Silva, Betina B. Hinckel, Óscar Carvalho, Ana Leal
pmc-13249530.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Therapeutic ultrasound (US) and photobiomodulation (PBM) are promising treatment modalities for restoring articular cartilage. Owing to their different mechanisms of action, individual or combined stimulation may elicit different bioeffects on chondrocytes. This study aimed to evaluate the potential of US and PBM, applied alone or combined, in augmenting chondrocytes' responses toward cartilage matrix synthesis and reverting their catabolic activities, with or without interleukin-1β (IL-1β) incubation.

pmc-13397790.title: Efficacy of uterine artery ascending branch ligation for preventing postpartum hemorrhage in Caesarean section for placenta previa
pmc-13397790.creator: Le Xu, Yihong Yang, Ying Zhu
pmc-13397790.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundPostpartum hemorrhage (PPH) remains a leading cause of maternal morbidity and mortality globally. This study aimed to assess the efficacy of ascending uterine artery ligation (AUAL) in preventing PPH among patients undergoing cesarean section (CS) for placenta previa.MethodsA retrospective cohort study was conducted at our institution between January 2022 and December 2024, enrolling 103 patients with placenta previa who underwent CS with concurrent AUAL.

pmc-13401468.title: Lymphogranuloma Venereum (LGV) Proctocolitis Presenting As Small Bowel Obstruction in an HIV-Negative Man Who Has Sex With Men (MSM) on Pre-exposure Prophylaxis (PrEP): A Diagnostic Dilemma
pmc-13401468.creator: Sneha Adidam, Anna C Pinelo, Pinky Bai, Abay Gobezie, Muhammad Ahmad Imran, Mekdem Bisrat, Naga Sai Shravan Turaga, Farshad Aduli, Huda Gasmelseed
pmc-13401468.description: Lymphogranuloma venereum (LGV) is an aggressive, sexually transmitted infection caused by specific serovars (L1-L3) of Chlamydia trachomatis. Historically considered endemic to tropical regions, LGV has re-emerged in developed nations in recent decades, predominantly affecting men who have sex with men (MSM).

pmc-13412341.title: Artificial intelligence for battlefield triage in large-scale combat operations: Opportunities, limits, and ethical considerations
pmc-13412341.creator: Quentin Mathais, Pierre-Julien Cungi, Antoine Lamblin, Olivier Dubourg, Julien Bordes, Salah Boussen
pmc-13412341.description: :Large-scale combat operations (LSCOs) impose major constraints on battlefield medical systems, combining sustained casualty inflow, degraded communications, prolonged evacuation timelines, and limited opportunities for repeated clinical reassessment. Under such conditions, conventional triage frameworks—designed for episodic assessment and rapid evacuation—become insufficient.

pmc-13550533.title: Assessing conventionally bred lentil (Lens culinaris Medik) cultivars for adaptation to organic cropping systems in the southeastern USA
pmc-13550533.creator: Dil Thavarajah, Mark Dempsey, Tristan Lawrence, Emerson Shipe, Shiv Kumar
pmc-13550533.description: The increasing demand for organic plant-based protein calls for research aimed at adapting new specialty cash crops for winter production instead of leaving farmland fallow or using cover crops. Organic breeding programs for lentil (Lens culinaris Medik) are limited globally, and conventionally bred lentil cultivars are not well-adapted to organic systems.
